reading.title: Store notice
reading.text: Thank you for shopping with us! You can return or exchange any item within 14 days. Please bring your receipt. Shoes must be unworn and in the original box. Sale items can be exchanged but not refunded. If you have any questions, ask a member of staff or email us at help@example.com.

questions.q: How long do customers have to return an item?
What is true about sale items?
choices: They can be exchanged but not refunded
They must be returned in 7 days

reading.title: Retail trends
reading.text: Although online sales continue to grow, physical stores remain essential for footwear brands, largely because customers still want to try shoes on before buying. However, the role of the store is changing. Rather than simply holding inventory, successful stores now act as showrooms where staff educate customers and build loyalty. One brand reported that customers who visited a store first were twice as likely to make repeat purchases online, even though their initial purchase was smaller. The implication is clear: measuring a store only by the sales rung up at its own register underestimates its true contribution.

questions.q: Why do physical stores remain important for footwear brands?
choices: Customers want to try shoes on

questions.q: What did the brand find about customers who visited a store first?
choices: They spent more on their first purchase
They were less likely to buy online
They were more likely to buy again online

questions.q: What does the final sentence imply?
choices: In-store sales alone understate a store's value
Online sales should be measured in stores
